benchmark.worse_rows_read: All four are the placeholder strip, not the table: against the table-alone arm the table has 0 worse rows, and the strip alone is 0 improved / 4 worse / aggregate -0.31. Every one is the same class -- a GT `_Bool` one-byte stack local that spelled `bool` and now spells `char`, in two distinct functions (ls/dir/vdir are one program). Both functions have an alloca-shaped frame whose stack pointer is itself a variable, which is the shape that kept the placeholder in the first place. It is core type inference, not `boolbyte`: `--option boolbyte off` changes neither arm's rendering of those slots. Read at the statement level (cp make_dir_parents_private, slot -0x1ad): the callee whose parameter the slot feeds still declares `bool a3` in BOTH arms, the defs and tests are the same statements, and the emitted C stays correct -- the slot is `char` and each test casts it (`if ((bool)v26)`). What moves is which vote the merged variable folds, alongside one extra level of block nesting around the def. A metric loss on the `bool` class, not wrong output, and not `boolbyte`'s.

placeholder_strip.what: Heritage::clearStackPlaceholders was an unported stub (only the flag was cleared), so the stack-pointer placeholder ActionFuncLink appends to every CALL was never removed from a call whose callee carries a DECLARED prototype -- such a call's input list is locked, so no later pass rewrites it. It rendered as one argument past the declared arity, reading the slot the `call` pushed its return address into.
placeholder_strip.pre_existing: On origin/main, ginstall alone renders 13 such calls (free, strlen, strcmp, stat, fstatat ...); the widened table made the class visible on 24 more sites because it declares 333 more names. Both arms are fixed.
placeholder_strip.no_option: A strict bug fix: the emitted call contradicted the prototype the same output declares, and reading the return-address slot has no reading under which it is right.

corpus.phantom_trailing_arguments_note: 161 on origin/main's OWN default over the 12 binaries (103 of them with `libcsigs off` as well, i.e. from the 28-entry base table alone) -- 0 in every arm of this branch.
